title: GTA 6 Gift Guide 2026: Best Gifts for a GTA 6 Fan (PS5 and Xbox)
desc: Buying for a GTA 6 fan? The game itself, storage for the 212 GB install, a second controller and a headset, plus what to check before you buy (console, region, digital vs box).
lede: Shopping for someone who can't stop talking about GTA 6? Here's what actually helps, in order, and the three things to check so the gift works on their console.
sections: If they don't have it yet, this is the gift. The boxed versions are a download code in a box (no disc), which makes it easy to wrap. Check which console they have: PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. There's no PS4, Xbox One or PC version.
2. Storage: the gift they'll actually notice

GTA 6 is up to 212 GB, so a lot of players run out of space. On PS5, look for a 2 TB M.2 NVMe SSD (PCIe Gen4) with a heatsink. On Xbox Series X|S, it has to be an official storage expansion card. What to look for.
Long sessions drain batteries. A second controller means one charges while they play, and it's easy to pick: it just has to match the console.
Vice City is loud: traffic, radio, chaos. A comfortable headset that works with their console is a gift they'll use every day.

• Console: PS5 vs Xbox Series X|S, everything has to match.
  • Region: Amazon's PS5 code works for US or Canada PlayStation accounts.
  • Price: check the price history around Black Friday (Nov 27) and Cyber Monday (Nov 30). Black Friday guide.
faq: What is a good gift for a GTA 6 fan?
The game if they don't have it yet; otherwise storage (GTA 6 is up to 212 GB), a second controller or a headset that matches their console.
Can you gift GTA 6 as a physical copy?
Yes, but the boxed version is a download code in a box with no disc, so it works on digital-only consoles too.
